🇯🇵🇺🇸🇵🇭#JGSDF participating in the exercise #JPMRC / #SALAKNIB26 held in the Philippines from 6 APR to 20 MAY 2026, conducted live fire exercise and biological agent response training.
In live fire exercise from 1 to 2 MAY, the 12th Brigade conducted the firing of mobile combat vehicles and mortars with the Philippines Army. Also in biological response training from 4 to 8 MAY, the NBC Countermeasure Medical unit conducted biological agent response training with the U.S. Army’s and Philippines Army.
Through this exercise, JGSDF will enhance its operational capabilities and strengthen cooperation with ally and like-minded partners.
